title: UGREEN CM511 USB-C Multifunction 6-in-1 Docking Station

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The UGREEN CM511 USB-C 6-in-1 Docking Station is a compact and versatile solution for expanding the connectivity of your laptop, tablet, or USB-C enabled device. Designed for productivity and convenience, it combines multiple essential ports into a single device, making it ideal for office, home, and travel use.


This multifunction hub features HDMI output for 4K display, multiple USB 3.0 ports for high-speed data transfer, and SD/TF card slots for quick access to memory cards. It also supports USB-C Power Delivery (PD), allowing you to charge your device while using the hub.


With its plug-and-play design, the CM511 requires no additional drivers and is compatible with a wide range of devices including laptops, MacBooks, tablets, and smartphones. Built with durable materials and a compact form factor, it ensures reliable performance and portability.


Key Features


  • 6-in-1 multifunction USB-C docking station
  • HDMI output with 4K display support
  • Multiple USB 3.0 ports for fast data transfer
  • SD & TF card reader slots
  • USB-C Power Delivery (PD) charging support
  • Plug & play – no driver required
  • Compact, lightweight, and portable design
  • Wide compatibility with laptops, MacBooks, tablets
